voiceGuide: Instructs 1st graders to build a growing sequence step-by-step: Soil, Seed, Water, Sun, and Sprout. Reinforces botanical requirements through gameplay actions.

welcome.text: Hello, Little Gardener! Let's help some plants grow up! Find the card to start.

need_soil.text: First, we need a warm bed for our plant. What resource keeps the roots safe?

need_seed.text: Wonderful! Now we need something small to plant in the ground. What do we place inside the soil?

need_water.text: Our seed is tucked in! What drink makes the dry soil nice and moist?

need_sun.text: Perfect! Now we need natural light to keep our growing seed warm. What shines high in the sky?

need_sprout.text: Look closely! What starts to pop up out of the earth when it gets warmth and moisture?

soil_ok.text: Fantastic! Healthy soil holds our plant steady and holds water for the roots.

seed_ok.text: That is right! Inside every small seed is a tiny baby plant waiting to wake up!

water_ok.text: Yum! Soil drinks up the rain. Our little seed is absorbing water to grow!

sun_ok.text: Super! Sunlight gives plants the energy they need to make food!

sprout_ok.text: Yes! The green sprout is growing big, tall, and strong!

wrong.text: Not quite yet! Think about what our little plant needs next.

round_done.text: Wow! Look at that beautiful plant you helped grow!

all_done.text: Outstanding work! You helped all of our seeds grow up. You are a real master gardener!
